priorityList: --- Icy Veins Voidweaver Rotation (Hero-Spec Specific) ---
Keep Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain active at all times. Use Tentacle Slam to apply or refresh if available.
Maintain Shadow Word: Madness uptime without capping Insanity.
Use short-cooldown Insanity generators (e.g., Void Volley or Mind Blast).
Use long cooldowns (e.g., Void Torrent) when they will not cause you to lose short-cooldown use.
Use long cooldowns (e.g., Halo) when they will not cause you to lose short-cooldown use.
Fill with Mind Flay when nothing higher priority is available.
Use Tentacle Slam to get your DoTs rolling. If this is on cooldown as you pull the pack, you need to do your best to DoT as many targets manually as possible while weaving in other spells.

At this point, your highest priority is maintaining DoTs. You should pick a main priority target to funnel in your Shadow Word: Madness into. This is typically the target with the highest amount of health or a particularly powerful enemy.
--- WoWhead Voidweaver Opener ---
Precast Mind Blast.
Cast Tentacle Slam.
Cast Shadow Word: Pain
Cast Halo.
Cast Voidform.
Cast Power Infusion + Use Tempered Potion + Any on use trinkets
Cast Void Volley.
Precast Mind Blast.
Cast Tentacle Slam.
Cast Shadow Word: Pain.
Cast Voidform.
Cast Power Infusion + Use Tempered Potion + Any on use trinkets.
Cast Void Volley.
Cast Shadow Word: Madness.
Cast Void Torrent.
Cast Void Blast.
--- WoWhead Voidweaver Rotation ---
Cast Shadow Word: Pain if Shadow Word: Pain is not active.
Maintain Vampiric Touch, either with Tentacle Slam or hard cast Vampiric Touch
Cast Halo.
Cast Voidform to enter Voidform.
Cast Power Infusion.
Cast Void Volley.
Spend Insanity on Shadow Word: Madness if it is not active, is about to fall off, or you are about to cap.
Cast Mind Flay: Insanity if Shadow Word: Madness is active.
Cast Mind Blast.
Cast Shadow Word: Madness if Voidform is active.
Cast Tentacle Slam if there will be no additional targets to DoT or upcoming movement.
Cast Mind Flay, interrupting as soon as anything of higher priority becomes available.
When moving, cast Tentacle Slam, Shadow Word: Death, or Shadow Word: Pain to generate some Insanity and deal some damage.
Cast Shadow Word: Pain to maintain Shadow Word: Pain.
Maintain Vampiric Touch, either with Tentacle Slam or hard cast Vampiric Touch
Cast Voidform to enter Voidform.
Cast Power Infusion.
Cast Shadow Word: Death if the target has an absorb shield.
Cast Void Blast if Shadow Word: Madness is active or if Entropic Rift is about to expire.
Spend Insanity on Shadow Word: Madness if it is not active, is about to fall off, you are about to cap, or Entropic Rift is active.
Cast Void Volley.
Cast Void Torrent to activate Entropic Rift.
Cast Mind Blast.
Cast Shadow Word: Madness.
Cast Tentacle Slam if there will be no additional targets to DoT or upcoming movement.
Cast Mind Flay, interrupting as soon as anything of higher priority becomes available.
When moving, cast Tentacle Slam, Shadow Word: Death, or Shadow Word: Pain to generate some Insanity and deal some damage.
